verdict.rationale: React docs explicitly state that on the server React can stream HTML while data is still being fetched, progressively filling in content before JavaScript loads, directly matching the story. This is corroborated by hydrateRoot and 'use client'/RSC docs showing the streaming SSR + hydration architecture. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark or community corroboration of perceived load improvements, and more detail on APIs like renderToPipeableStream.
